boundary_checks.subject: Local synchronization
boundary_checks.detail: Remote access synchronizes locally running sessions, not GitHub-hosted execution. Hosted execution points to a separate guide.

boundary_checks.subject: Runtime option
boundary_checks.detail: Always-on client option applies only when starting child/in-process runtime; ignored against already-running runtime. On-demand RPC remains a separate source procedure.

boundary_checks.subject: Repository and authentication
boundary_checks.detail: GitHub repository prerequisite is distinct from silent skip in always-on/nonrepo mode and errors on-demand. Authentication alternatives remain conditional, not simultaneous token/login obligations.

boundary_checks.subject: Permission shapes
boundary_checks.detail: allowed:true TS/Python objects are source-shaped examples without validated authorization-contract claims; other permissive handlers are not adopted authorization.

boundary_checks.subject: Go/Rust URL extraction
boundary_checks.detail: Always-on infoType checks and URL extraction are comment-only in Go/Rust. Go errors are discarded/unchecked; Rust receiver and question-mark behavior preserve error limitations.

boundary_checks.subject: Sharing and packages
boundary_checks.detail: URL, link and QR suggestions do not authorize publication or reveal private session contents. Referenced QR dependencies are not installed or linked-source reviewed.
